taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-19, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 609.2 | 25.53 | 25.53
2 | 7309.9 | 22.02 | 47.55
3 | 4367.7 | 0.42 | 47.97
4 | 4556.7 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as KQ-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-19, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station T-19 (Area T)**

A 4-layer VES model was resolved for Station T-19:
- **Layer 1** (0–25.53 m): 609.2 Ω·m
- **Layer 2** (25.53–47.55 m): 7,309.9 Ω·m
- **Layer 3** (47.55–47.97 m): 4,367.7 Ω·m
- **Layer 4** (>47.97 m): 4,556.7 Ω·m

The sounding is classified on file as KQ-type. However, evaluating the resistivity transitions reveals $\rho_1 < \rho_2 > \rho_3$ (K-type) for the first triplet and $\rho_2 > \rho_3 < \rho_4$ (H-type) for the second triplet. The correct classification is KH-type. Consequently, the on-file KQ label is incorrect and does not match the interpreted layer sequence.

{"curve_type_stated": "KQ", "label_issue_flagged": true}
